links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-5 versus retina specialists in predicting FTMH surgery outcomes on same cases
links.effect: Anatomical accuracy 72-86% (specialists) vs 90% (ChatGPT-5); functional accuracy 42-44% (specialists) vs 66% (ChatGPT-5), but ChatGPT missed all nonclosure cases and worsened cases (optimism bias).
links.quote: The anatomical prediction accuracy was 72% to 86% (specialists) and 90% (ChatGPT-5).

links.outcome: Optimism bias and missed adverse outcomes in ChatGPT-5 predictions
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 failed to identify nonclosure; 0% accuracy for worsened cases, <=13% for stable; mean BCVA error 11.4 ± 10.8 letters, ~60% within two lines.
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved perfect accuracy in closure cases but failed to identify nonclosure, reflecting optimism bias.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative study evaluating the diagnostic/predictive accuracy of ChatGPT vs retina specialists on macular hole surgery outcomes without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
